name: hover-card
blurb: Compound HoverCard component with trigger, content, and arrow support.
description: Radix-based hover card system with three parts: HoverCard (root), HoverCardTrigger (activator), and HoverCardContent (popover). Supports animations on open/close and optional arrow.
use_when: Rich hover previews that need structured content (not just text).
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.
a11y: Trigger must be a focusable element; hover card is not keyboard-accessible.
